A '''battle''' took place on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]]<ref name="Wild Space" /> in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]]<ref name="Date" /> during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], an inter-[[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] conflict. [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Ki-Adi-Mundi/Legends|Ki-Adi-Mundi]] led [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Troop/Legends|troops]] against the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederate]] [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborg]] [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] and his [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]]. Eventually, Grievous had his [[Droid/Legends|droid]] forces raze an entire [[Unidentified Ord Mantell township|township]] to divert the Republic troops, so that he could make his escape. The massacre was so great that even the stoic Mundi wept when he gave a report about the battle to the [[Jedi Council/Legends|Jedi Council]].<ref name="Wild Space" />

==Behind the scenes==
The battle was briefly mentioned in ''[[The Clone Wars: Wild Space]]'', a novel written by [[Karen Miller]] and published in [[2008]].<ref name="Wild Space" />
